title: Importing Tileset s as Event images, encountering alignment bug

posts.author: Prost
posts.body:
Hey y'all! I'll explain my intent first, execution second, and then explain the issue I am encountering.
What I want:
I want to use walls as "Above Player" objects, to represent doorways or arches above the player. Because empty events can be above the player, I have been using events to this end.
Execution:
By default, the Tileset A is not present in the images you can select for an event (Tileset_B and _C are). I'm not sure why it isn't. To solve this, and use walls as "doorframes," I exported Tileset_A's artwork (The default asset SF_Inside), imported a version cropped to match character dimensions as a "character" (where other event art like Doors appears to live).
Issue:
This functions fine, except the art when used on events appears to have a vertical offset of 1-2 pixels. Doors, on the other hand, do not suffer this issue, despite being events. See image; the "archway" crossing the hall to the left of the image is made of events using wall artwork as their image.
How do I solve this/what causes this? Is there a better strategy to get "doorframe" style tiles into a scene?
Thanks a bunch for reading. Love you all.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
You should learn to use the correct RM-terminology, because no one here has ever heard of "entities".
Best guess from context is that you're talking about events and sprites.
In that case (as you could read in the help file) you're talking about people sprites and object sprites.
People sprites are automatically displaced up by 8 pixel or so to appear walking inside the grid instead of on its borders.
Object sprites (door, crystals, statues and so on)  disable that displacement by having a ! at the beginning of their filenames.
EDIT: and if your displacement is really only 2 pixel instead of 8 with sprites, then you messed up the sprite cell format as well and might have to correct that in addition to the !

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Why do you keep saying Entity when the word in RPG Maker is Event?
Prost said:
By default, the Tileset A is not present in the images you can select for an
entity
(Tileset_B and _C are). I'm not sure why it isn't.
Click to expand...
Because the whole point of autotiles is that they are
automatically
constructed during play. There's no A ceiling tile where you can just take the tile from the sheet and plop it on the map. The tile in the game is constructed on the fly from segments of the 2x3 section on the sheet, depending on what's around it.
Prost said:
This functions fine, except the art when used on
entites
appears to have a vertical offset of 1-2 pixels.
Click to expand...
6, actually. If you read the instructions for character spritesheets (Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards) you'll see that you get rid of that by placing a ! at the beginning of the file name, just like all of your doors have.
